title: Reppeling Horse
body:
Ever wanted to go with your horse straddling? Now you can with repelling and slowing down


<details>
<summary>When updated?</summary>

comming soon in older versions! :)

</details>


<details>
<summary>Can you walk normally with the horse?</summary>

You can't walk normally

</details>


<details>
<summary>How to</summary>

1. Get a horse
2. A saddle
3. Tame the horse
4. Ride the horse
   
> Kick it with (**Default R**)

or

> Press (**Default C**) to repel

</details>
